booking.instructions: Call (512) 828-7663 to schedule your free inspection, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

demo_chips: How much does a roof replacement cost?
How do I book a free inspection?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Summit Roofing at (512) 828-7663 or office@summitrooftexas.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: Do you help with insurance claims?
faqs.a: Yes. We document storm damage properly and guide homeowners through the claims process from start to finish - about 95% of our work involves insurance claims in some form, and your out-of-pocket cost is typically limited to your deductible.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential roof replacements can be completed in one day.

faqs.q: Is the online estimate the final price?
faqs.a: No. The online estimate is a helpful starting point that gives you a reliable pricing range. Final pricing is confirmed after an on-site inspection of the actual roof measurements, pitch, material selection, decking condition and project details.

pricing.summary: Roof inspections are always free, and our site offers an instant online estimate that gives you a price range for planning - the final price is confirmed after an in-person inspection, because it depends on roof size, pitch, material selection and decking condition. Metal roofing typically runs $12-$25 per square foot, and TPO roofing $5-$12 per square foot. If your job goes through insurance, your out-of-pocket cost is typically limited to your deductible, and financing is available for qualified homeowners.
